repositories.notes: Same real, stock image as the plain "alpine" SIBLING entry below -- no droidtop-published image needed. sway isn't preinstalled; DroidSpacesRuntime provisions it into the pulled rootfs on first boot via this distro's own package manager (see CompositorProvisioning, keyed on os+desktopEnvironment), matching docs/SPEC.md §2a's "OCI images stay stock, injected at runtime" -- not baked into a custom image. sway's headless backend (WLR_BACKENDS=headless) is well-documented (ArchWiki, Gentoo wiki) and is already droidtop's own reference compositor (vendor/sway).

Same stock image as "alpine-sway" -- provisioned with labwc instead via CompositorProvisioning. labwc supports WLR_BACKENDS=headless + WLR_LIBINPUT_NO_DEVICES=1 (labwc's own actions docs, real wayvnc use). A 2022 headless assertion-failure report (labwc/labwc#605) may or may not still apply to current releases -- not independently re-verified by droidtop.

Same real, stock image as the plain "debian" SIBLING entry below -- provisioned with sway on first boot the same way as "alpine-sway" (see CompositorProvisioning); glibc base instead of musl for anyone who needs it. UNVERIFIED end to end -- never booted against a live droidspaces container (no rooted test device in this environment); see DroidSpacesRuntime's own doc comment for the specific assumptions (env_file injection timing, seatd sufficing without systemd-logind, first-boot network access for the package install).

Same stock image as "alpine-sway"; not actually provisionable yet -- CompositorProvisioning has no alpine/hyprland entry, so selecting this fails fast with a clear error rather than silently falling back. Not recommended even if it were: multiple open upstream issues report headless/virtual outputs broken on current Hyprland (hyprwm/Hyprland#7917, #8806) since it forked off wlroots onto its own Aquamarine backend in 2024. Listed for visibility/filtering, not as a working recommendation.

Official Arch Linux Docker image is amd64-only -- no arm64 build (confirmed via gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/archlinux-docker#29). Unusable on droidtop's ARM64 target as-is; a third-party rebuild (e.g. menci/docker-archlinuxarm) would need its own entry, not added here yet.
openSUSE's own Tumbleweed image lists linux/386, linux/amd64, linux/arm platforms; the ARM variant's exact architecture (armv7 vs. arm64) wasn't independently confirmed in this research pass.
Void's own current containers are at ghcr.io/void-linux/void-*, confirmed to publish linux/arm64 -- not Docker Hub's voidlinux/voidlinux, which is stale (unmaintained for years).
